title: American Express Business - Corporate cards and B2B payment automation
clean_text: American Express offers B2B payment solutions including the Corporate Purchasing Card (CPC) for procurement-to-payment automation and vPayment, a virtual card solution that assigns a unique virtual card number per transaction with configurable amount, date range, and spend controls for easier reconciliation. Amex's Global Commercial Services team has relationships with nearly 60% of Fortune Global 500 companies, targeting Fortune 1000 and multinationals needing global acceptance, spend control, and analytics, while also expanding virtual-card access to small business owners that was previously corporate-only. American Express cards are accepted at an estimated 160 million merchant locations worldwide as of mid-2025, up nearly 5x since 2017, reaching 99% US acceptance parity with other major networks since the end of 2019.

meta.target: Fortune 1000 and multinationals, expanding to SMBs
meta.pricing_model: annual card fee plus merchant discount rate
